name: Teriyaki Sauce
siboNotes: Use sparingly due to fructose and fructan content from high fructose corn syrup and garlic. Consider making homemade versions with low-FODMAP sweeteners.
preparationTips: Look for brands without garlic powder or onion powder
Make homemade using tamari, maple syrup, and ginger
Use as a finishing sauce rather than marinade to control portions
Check labels for high fructose corn syrup and avoid those brands
alternatives: Homemade sauce with tamari and maple syrup
Low-sodium soy sauce with brown sugar
Coconut aminos with rice wine vinegar
Tamari with ginger and sesame oil
nutritionalHighlights: Contains some B vitamins from soy base
Generally low in protein and fiber
